release.change: New files are saved to Internal storage/Download by default, with no setup or storage permission on Android 10 and newer
Add destinations with the system folder picker, including SD cards and other storage apps
Links are downloaded straight into the chosen destination, with the result shown when the download has finished
Saving shows its progress and can be cancelled
Phone Saver is now DropFiler - a modernized fork of "Phone Saver".
Open with DropFiler: save a copy of a file from a file manager
New HyperOS-inspired design built with HiMiuix
Light and dark themes, plus optional dynamic colors on Android 12+
Grouped settings and a quicker share destination sheet
Direct Share on Android 10 and newer
Last version of the original "Phone Saver" app.
So long and thanks for all the fish!
